title: 雄鹿总裁亲口说：Uline是最大合作伙伴，比摩托罗拉还大吗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I'm told that you've just struck a deal that goes into effect this season for U-line to be the official patch on the front of the Milwaukee Bucks uniforms.
segments.zh: 听说你们刚达成协议，本赛季起Uline将成为密尔沃基雄鹿队球衣正面的官方补丁。

segments.en: That's right. We could be more excited. A month from today we'll tip off the season on the road at Washington and we're going to do that representing Wisconsin-based company U-Line as our new Jersey patch partner.
segments.zh: 没错，我们非常兴奋。一个月后的今天，我们将在客场华盛顿开启新赛季，届时我们将代表威斯康星州企业Uline作为新的球衣补丁合作伙伴。

segments.en: So we're going to wear them for every regular season game, every playoff game on our practice jersey, on our summer league jerseys.
segments.zh: 所以我们将穿着它们参加每一场常规赛、每一场季后赛，还有我们的训练服和夏季联赛球衣。

segments.en: They will become our biggest and largest partner and we're incredibly excited to announce that today.
segments.zh: 他们将成为我们最大、最重要的合作伙伴，我们今天非常激动地宣布这一消息。

segments.en: You've had a relationship with U-Line for a while. I mean, they've been involved obviously in the Bucks and the Bucks stadium.
segments.zh: 你们与Uline的关系已经有一段时间了。他们显然参与了雄鹿队和雄鹿队球馆的事务。

segments.en: Give me a sense here as to what changes beyond just the patch.
segments.zh: 请告诉我，除了补丁之外，还会有什么变化？

segments.en: Yeah, it's elevating the platform. It's continuing to show up on behalf of our employees, on behalf of within the community.
segments.zh: 是的，这提升了平台。它继续代表我们的员工，代表社区展现。

segments.en: These partnerships where you have a relationship, they're the best.
segments.zh: 这些有关系的合作伙伴关系是最好的。

segments.en: We get a running to start. We know exactly how to work together. We know how to communicate.
segments.zh: 我们一开始就顺利运转。我们清楚如何合作，如何沟通。

segments.en: We care deeply about their employees.
segments.zh: 我们深切关心他们的员工。

segments.en: We care deeply about our fans as do they, you know, my sister works at U-Line.
segments.zh: 我们非常关心球迷，他们也是。我妹妹就在U-Line工作。

segments.en: So the opportunity for us to elevate everything we're doing is incredible.
segments.zh: 所以对我们来说，能提升所做的一切，机会难得。

segments.en: I do it fast, you know. I mean, when I think about, I mean, your past partnership was with Motorola, pretty well-known brand.
segments.zh: 我做事很快。想想看，你们之前的合作伙伴是摩托罗拉，知名品牌。

segments.en: You've had relationships with companies like Harley-Davidson. These are very consumer, froked, focused brands.
segments.zh: 你们和哈雷戴维森这样的公司合作过。这些都是非常面向消费者的品牌。

segments.en: U-Line is more B2B. So what's the appeal for, I guess, just the average fan that comes into that stadium?
segments.zh: U-Line更偏向B2B。那么对于普通球迷来说，走进球场的吸引力是什么？

segments.en: Why do they need to know what U-Line is?
segments.zh: 他们为什么需要知道U-Line是什么？
